correctness.rationale: For f(x)=x^2+1 on Z_7, the two fixed roots are alpha≡3, beta≡5 (mod7), alpha≡31, beta≡19 (mod49); multipliers 2alpha and 2beta have residue orders e=2 and 6, with lambda_alpha^2≡22, lambda_beta^6≡15 mod49. Their return-map quadratic coefficients vanish modulo 7 and linear displacement has valuation m+1 for points in depth-m shells. Odd-prime cycle lifting then yields lengths e*7^j and corresponding minimal odometers; three alpha sign-orbit components and one beta six-orbit shell at each m. Residue precursor branches are two for alpha and four for beta; critical residue zero enters B1 with measure 1/7, giving alpha basin 4/7^{m+1}, beta B1=31/49, Bm(m>=2)=24/7^{m+1}. Totals 2/7 and 5/7. Independent modular branch and cycle counts checked mod 7^2,7^3,7^4, supporting but not replacing all-depth proof.
